title: The Socratic PAUSE: safeguarding scientific judgement at AI speed
abstract: arXiv:2611.34222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI can turn a tentative scientific question into hypotheses, methods, code and interpretations within minutes. Yet generating a contribution does not establish that it deserves scientific reliance: researchers must still examine its evidence, assumptions and implications, and remain accountable for the decision to rely on it. Using Einstein's sketch of scientific discovery as a lens, we argue that AI has accelerated discovery far more than justification. In human-AI research partnerships, confidence can therefore outgrow evidence through three mechanisms: recursive reinforcement, loss of provenance and miscalibrated reliance on AI-generated contributions. Verification debt accumulates when such contributions are carried into later claims or decisions without adequate scrutiny. translated_title: 苏格拉底式暂停：在AI速度下守护科学判断
translated_abstract: 生成式AI可以在几分钟内将一个初步的科学问题转化为假设、方法、代码和解释。然而，生成一项贡献并不意味着它值得科学上的信赖：研究人员仍必须审视其证据、假设与影响，并对依赖该贡献的决定保持问责。以爱因斯坦的科学发现图景为视角，我们论证了AI对“发现”的加速远超过对“论证”的加速。因此，在人机研究合作中，信心可能通过三种机制超越证据：递归强化、来源信息丢失，以及对AI生成贡献的失准依赖。当这些贡献未经充分审查就被纳入后续的论断或决策时，验证债务便会不断累积。据此，我们提出“苏格拉底式暂停”，作为在关键决策节点上设置的一种审慎检查点，使AI贡献在其中保持暂定状态。
tldr: 论文提出“苏格拉底式暂停”机制，在关键科学决策节点设置审慎检查点并保持AI贡献的暂定性，以应对AI加速发现快于论证所导致的验证债务累积与信心超越证据的风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "Socratic Pause," a deliberate checkpoint at consequential decision gates where AI contributions remain provisional, safeguarding scientific judgement against verification debt and confidence outgrowing evidence in human-AI research partnerships.
